notes: Redesigned main menu as a floating card with hover/open animations; removed the bottom bar (language & region now live in Settings). Tabs now slide when opened, closed, or reordered instead of snapping. Fixed a bug where dragging a tab could glitch/misalign the tab strip. The app now always opens with a single tab first, then asks (top-right, non-blocking) whether to restore your previous tabs, instead of silently restoring them. Startup now does a deliberate fade-in instead of popping the window in instantly. Update prompt copy now says tabs will be restored after updating.
